home.heroTitle: Quiet, space and comfort at the gateway to the Wachau
home.heroLead: Fully equipped apartments in Markersdorf-Haindorf, 15 km from Melk Abbey. Terrace with a view, your own kitchen, free Wi-Fi and parking.
home.introTitle: A beautiful place to enjoy life
introParagraphs: Haus MaryLu is located in Winkel, 15 km from Melk Abbey and about 10 km from the Danube, and offers free Wi-Fi and free private parking.

Each unit features a terrace with a view, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a fully equipped kitchen and two private bathrooms, with a shower and a hairdryer. Guests also have a minibar, a stovetop, a toaster, a coffee machine and an electric kettle.
Guests can relax in the property's garden, and the motorway is only minutes away.
home.amenitiesTitle: Everything you need, already in the apartment
home.amenitiesLead: The apartments are set up for long stays just as well as for a single night on the road.

testimonials.quote: Very clean and tastefully furnished, a large apartment in a rural area. There are insect screens on all windows. The host was very friendly: after a short conversation about whether anything was missing, he immediately went shopping and left everything at our door. Comfortable beds, everything was first-class.
testimonials.author: Silvia

testimonials.quote: Very clean, quiet, spacious apartment, comfortable beds, well-equipped kitchen and a friendly host. It's easy to reach from the motorway, and there are many attractions nearby: the Wachau valley along the Danube with its picturesque towns and villages, Melk Abbey, Schallaburg Castle, Aggstein Castle, Grafenegg Castle and Göttweig Abbey.
testimonials.author: Daniela

testimonials.quote: Our one-night stay in this apartment was absolutely perfect! Everything exceeded our expectations — from the cleanliness to the comfort and attention to detail. Thank you so much for the warm welcome and hospitality!
testimonials.author: Cristina

home.nearbyLead: We sit on the edge of one of Austria's most beautiful regions, with quick access from the motorway.
home.boatNote: The Danube and its river port are about 10 km away, with daily boat trips throughout the season.

blocks.title: Peace, comfort and nature in Austria
paragraphs: Haus MaryLu is a charming guesthouse in a quiet area, close to Melk Abbey and the Danube valley – Wachau. It offers spacious, fully equipped rooms, a relaxing atmosphere and easy access from the motorway.
The ideal place for a peaceful holiday in the heart of Austrian nature.

blocks.title: Spacious apartments, comfort like home
paragraphs: At Haus MaryLu, the apartments are fully equipped to offer you a relaxing and worry-free stay. Each unit includes a modern kitchen, two private bathrooms, a terrace or balcony with a view, and all the amenities needed for everyday comfort.
Whether you're just passing through or planning a holiday in the Wachau region, here you'll find peace, privacy and authentic Austrian hospitality.
